Why psql::Query hands its query to psql on stdin: --set variables reach a
script psql reads and not a --command string. Re-record against the psql the
server runs when that version changes; tests/support::fake_psql stands in for
the refusal below.

$ psql --version
psql (PostgreSQL) 17.10

$ psql --csv --no-psqlrc --quiet --tuples-only --set foo=bar --set k=42 --command "select :'foo' as x, :k as y"
ERROR:  syntax error at or near ":"
LINE 1: select :'foo' as x, :k as y
               ^
exit=1

$ echo "select :'foo' as x, :k as y" | psql --csv --no-psqlrc --quiet --tuples-only --set foo=bar --set k=42 --file -
bar,42
exit=0
